how the 6 stars will be randomised
'as individual items': all 6 stars are individual items.
'progressive items': all 6 stars are progressive items. every progressive item is a slot in your squad and the thirteenth is the support unit
'exclude': no 6 stars will be included. Alternatively could be used as you can always use 6 stars
sets the amount of progressive 6 stars you can receive.
1 means that you can use 6 stars on all available squad slots,
2 means half, 3 a third, etc. to all 12 slots

'as individual items': all 5 stars are individual items.
